text:
Aisha Rahman: Quick thread to lock down GA scope for Inference Gateway v1 — target Nov 15. Need crisp answers on SLA targets, pricing SKUs, monitoring alerts, oncall rota, and public docs timeline.

Tom Lee: For SLAs propose: Hosted Tier-A 99.95% uptime, Dedicated 99.98%. Latency SLOs: embeddings p95 <= 40ms, small-gen p95 <= 120ms. We should also publish p50/p95 for cold starts.

Diego Alvarez: Agree. Add 5xx SLO: <0.1% rolling 1h. Also we must document fallback behavior: if model variant unavailable, route to compatible quantized variant in same region, and if region degraded route to secondary region.

Aisha Rahman: Good. Who owns the fallback policy text for public docs? Diego?

Diego Alvarez: I can author the fallback section and a short decision table (region vs variant). Will post PR today.

Tom Lee: Rate limits for Standard SKU: steady QPS 120, burst up to 400 for 30s, then token-based throttling. Dev SKU unlimited to 5 RPS for dev tokens. Enterprise: reserved throughput + SLA.

Aisha Rahman: Pricing owners: DocsBot, can you stub public pricing page and pricing examples?

DocsBot: Created draft pricing page under staging: https://docs.redwood.com/staging/igw-pricing. Included 3 SKUs and an example cost calc.

Diego Alvarez: Monitoring checklist for GA runbook: sustained p95 breach > 5m, error-rate >0.5% over 5m, saturation (GPU util >90%) for 10m, and cache hit rate drop >15%. Each alert must map to a runbook step and PD escalation.

Tom Lee: I'll wire those alerts into the dashboard and PagerDuty. Pull request will include sample queries and dashboard screenshot.

Aisha Rahman: Oncall: enterprise customers require 24/7 primary with ticket ack within 4h. Ops suggested rotation: 7-day pager stints with a 2-person primary. ops-bot, create the provisional rota and calendar invite.

ops-bot: Provisional rota "IGW GA oncall" created; calendar invites sent to Diego, Tom, +1. Runbook stub published at /runbooks/igw-ga. Reminder: runbook review Wed 10:00 PT.

Aisha Rahman: Docs timeline: internal release notes + runbook by Wed EOD, public doc conversion Thu AM after pricing locked. Who will own release notes? Diego take it.

Diego Alvarez: Taking release notes and fallback policy. Will open PR with bullets and known limitations.

Tom Lee: :white_check_mark: I'll post the alert PR by 6pm PT.

Diego Alvarez: :white_check_mark: for runbook + fallback PR (draft up).

DocsBot: :white_check_mark: pricing draft published to staging; will promote after final numbers.

Aisha Rahman: Final checklist recap (owners):
- SLA numbers (owner: Tom)
- Error-rate SLO + fallback policy (owner: Diego)
- Pricing SKUs + calc examples (owner: DocsBot)
- Runbook + rota (owner: Diego)
- Monitoring alerts -> PagerDuty + dashboards (owner: Tom)
- Public docs release (owner: DocsBot)

Aisha Rahman: If no blockers, Wed 10:00 PT runbook review will finalize signoffs. Drop any outstanding issues here before then.

Tom Lee: One open decision: do we advertise cold-start p95 in SLA or only in docs? Recommend docs only for GA. Thoughts?

Diego Alvarez: Docs only for GA — we don't have stable cold-start guarantees yet.

Aisha Rahman: Agreed. We'll keep cold-start metrics public but not SLA-bound for GA.

ops-bot: Smoke window scheduled Nov 14 02:00-03:00 UTC. Automated smoketests will run and post a summary.

Aisha Rahman: Thanks all, please react when your items are green so I can close the loop.
